name: Coloradisaurus
sum: Coloradisaurus is a massospondylid sauropodomorph from the Late Triassic (Norian) Los Colorados Formation of La Rioja Province, Argentina, known from two specimens.
wsnote: Estimate for the holotype individual quoted by the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: PVL 3967, a mostly complete skull found with an undescribed partial skeleton (La Esquina locality, upper Los Colorados Formation, near Pagancillo, La Rioja).
material: A referred partial skeleton (PVL 5904) with most of the dorsal vertebrae and parts of the shoulder and pelvic girdles and limbs; all material was found in 1971.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted beyond its description as a massospondylid sauropodomorph.
author: Lambert 1983
